mentions.name: Self-hostable workout tracking app
mentions.description: A lightweight, self-hostable workout tracking app that does what it needs to do and nothing more, built with Deno (TypeScript) and htmx.
mentions.problem: The only self-hosted option found (wger.de) was too feature-heavy for the author's needs; a lightweight app is wanted so it doesn't hog resources on a cheap VPS.
mentions.source_excerpt: technically a self-hostable workout tracking app.

evidence.value: technically a self-hostable workout tracking app.
